content: Good morning, Hillton Hotel. Can I help you?
Good morning. My name is William Woods. I'd like to book a single room with bath.
I'm afraid the single room has booked out, what about the double room with bath?
That's OK. By the way, how much is the fee per night?
$ 65. When will you be arriving and leaving, Sir?
From Monday, August 23rd to Saturday, August 28th.
Quite all right, Sir. Mr. William Woods, double room with bath, six nights. Is it right?
Yes, that's it. Thank you very much.
